name: Game of Fitna Vol. 1
source:
Set in 2030 within the elite Preisotus High School – Wisdom Heaven, "Game of Fitna Vol. 1" casts players as Zayn, the academy's lowest-ranked student. A mysterious message pulls Zayn and six classmates into a sinister "TEST" devised by the school itself. This is no ordinary academic trial, but a high-stakes death game demanding critical thinking, challenging trust, and forcing intense moral dilemmas where failure has dire consequences. Inspired by psychological thrillers and Arabian folklore, the narrative explores ambition, morality, and the price of success in a world where rank is everything.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2725340/]Steam[/url]]
